financing.summary: NOT A FOR-SALE HOMEBUILDER: Middleburg develops, builds and operates rental housing (apartments and Hamlet single-family build-to-rent), so it does not buy finished lots on a takedown schedule and is at best an edge-case land-banking customer. It funds each project separately: institutional joint-venture equity (Harbor Group International is the one LP named in 2026), its own GP co-invest from a discretionary fund series (GP Fund III closed at $125M in February 2026), bank construction loans (Truist and US Bank named) and agency take-out debt (Freddie Mac via Newmark). Sites are held under contract while GP fund money carries them through zoning and entitlement, and land usually closes together with the construction loan, which removes most of the need for a third-party land banker. The room for one is narrow: pre-development land carry or horizontal development on BTR sites if its 52-project, 18,000-unit pipeline outruns GP fund capital, especially in the new Western markets. The firm is also a capital provider (preferred equity and mezzanine funds for other sponsors), and its finance bench turned over in 2026, so relationships there are in flux. Corporate debt, cash and leverage are not public.
financing.land_strategy: Capital-light site control rather than land ownership: the land team sources off-market sites directly (750+ scored and 30+ contracted a year across eight states and 30+ metros), holds them under contract through entitlement, and closes the land when construction financing is in place. No stated owned/optioned target because it does not operate a lot pipeline. Company figures: 52 projects and 18,000+ units under control and in development, about 20 projects and 5,600 units under construction, 18 to 20 starts planned for 2026.

lots.source_title: Middleburg: named to NMHC Top 25 Developers and Builders lists
lots.note: No lot counts exist for this company. Its pipeline is counted in rental units: 52 projects under control and in development for 18,000+ units (April 2026), 4,150 units started in 2025 (up 62% year over year). These are apartment and BTR units on project sites, not for-sale lots, so the lot fields are left empty.

land_banking.description: The firm's own discretionary GP fund plays the role a land banker would: it funds the sponsor's equity and the pursuit phase. A development partner told the Phoenix Business Journal in June 2026 that a general partner fund lets him put sites under contract and carry them through zoning and entitlement. No third-party land banker or lot-option partner has been named publicly.
land_banking.source_title: Middleburg press release: GP Fund III final close at $125 million
land_banking.note: Fund size from the company release; the pursuit and entitlement use is from the Phoenix Business Journal article reposted at https://www.middleburg.com/news/virginia-real-estate-firm-taps-phoenix-partner-for-arizona-expansion (Reported).

capital_events.description: With Intelligence reported the firm is preparing Multifamily Credit Partners II, a $150 million closed-end fund providing preferred equity and mezzanine loans of $5M to $15M to other developers, launching spring 2026. It said the first credit fund raised $100 million plus a $200 million separate account, and that a US endowment committed $50 million to GP Fund III.
capital_events.source_title: With Intelligence, 'Middleburg readies $150m multifamily credit fund' (reposted on middleburg.com)
capital_events.note: Target size, not capital raised. Whether the fund launched or closed in 2026 is not public.

capital_events.description: SEC Form D for Middleburg GP Fund III, LP: $100 million offering, $40.975 million sold to 9 investors, first sale 30 June 2025, $1 million minimum, no placement agent. Signed by Kory L. Geans as CIO of the general partner.
capital_events.source_title: SEC Form D, Middleburg GP Fund III, LP (filed 2025-07-28)
capital_events.note: Offering amount later exceeded: the fund closed at $125M in February 2026. Middleburg Communities, LLC is named as sole member of the general partner.

capital_events.description: SEC Form D for Middleburg GP Fund II, LP: $75 million offering, $25 million sold to 2 investors at first filing. Context for the GP fund series.
capital_events.source_title: SEC Form D, Middleburg GP Fund II, LP (filed 2023-08-04)
capital_events.note: Final size of Fund II not found in a public source.
